posts.name: dshields
posts.cooked:
They Comfirmed that there will be one more expansion after Villians.

RPG got alot of good feedback, and praise.

Handlelabra will release beta for multiplayer in a few week on Steam. if you are on thier mailing list you will get an invite.

Sprit Island is 85-90% Compleated. (I think they said they are pushing for a kickstarter next year)

Promo pack of all promos will be relesed.

There may be future relased content for multiverse, (Like mini-expansions, maps etc..) but that the story arc will be finished.

They may release a Big Box that will hold all the cards (Christopher said one that you cannot lift lol)

Handlelabra are open to makeing other GTG games to digatal, they have had talks, but not till after SOTM is done.

There will be more to GSF in the future

The RPG will let you make your own hero as well as have "Stats" for all SOTM Hero's

GTG is looking to Publish more games, Chris from Dice hate me main job is to demo and present prospects. (Find Great games so we can give them all our money!!!)

And just in General talking to Diffrent People From GTG during Gen-Con, they are Busyer than ever, they are working to get Dice hate me games Republished so they are avaliable to buy, they are looking for new games to publish. (I saw at least 15 diffrent demo meetings). They are working to update the website, to include all aspects of the recent changes (Wrath, Dice hate me, Tactics etc...).

 

From my own perspective They look and seem to be on the verdge of takeing a big step to haveing a few populer games to a poupler "Brand". They are expanding to the point of becomeing Too Sucessfull to fit thier current setups. and they will have to become more creative in how they display and sell thier Products at these shows. They are going to have so many Populer games and not the Space to demo, and to do more live and diffrent tournaments and such. They will need to expand thier equpment, and resorces to keep up with the demand of more and more fans. It will be an exciteing time, but I feel for them becasue they will also have alot of stress and problems.

 

So wish them all well, and Know that the Future of GTG will be Very Exciting, and that with a group of dedacted great people, they will really keep blowing our socks off.

 

Dennis Shields

(This is as much as I remember, I left out the who is the hardest to code etc... questions just the things people I feel would be most instreasted in).
